post.description:
Import a glossary into one language's set guide as a new version by the user, all or
nothing. `base_version`: the guide version the preview showed (none for a set without a
guide); a newer one refuses the import (409 `guide_changed`). Terms the guide has with
another translation keep it unless `overwrite_conflicts`, locked ones too; `lock_all` locks
every imported term. With nothing to change, no version is added.

409.description: The guide changed since the preview.

413.description: The file is larger than the upload limit.

422.description: The file cannot be read, or a term, translation or note is over 2,000 characters; the message names the line.

post.description:
What importing a CSV, TSV or TBX glossary into one language's set guide would do: how
many terms are new, already there, or there with another translation. Writes nothing. A
term, translation or note over 2,000 characters, more than a guide edit may hold, is
refused with its line (422).
`source_lang`: the language of a TBX file's terms (default: the set's, else the file's
one other language, else that of the set's documents).

413.description: The file is larger than the upload limit.

422.description: The file cannot be read, or a term, translation or note is over 2,000 characters; the message names the line.

get.description:
Server-sent events: `progress` (a RunProgress) whenever it changes; `deleted` if the
run is deleted. The stream ends after a terminal state.

`comments` applies to bilingual-docx: the flags as Word comments. `reviewed_only` applies
to tmx: only the passages a person accepted or edited, with the text they approved.

post.description:
CGL-109 "This form is fine": dismiss an open terminology flag because the passage uses an
accepted form of the translation. The form joins the guide entry in a new approved version of
the set guide; rechecking the set clears the same flag where the form is used elsewhere.

Approve the guide of a run waiting at the checkpoint, as generated or edited; the run
continues translating. Refused (409) when the project guide is no longer the one the draft
was built from or, with an edited `guide` and a `base_version` of the project guide, no
longer that version: reload it and approve the current guide. Refused (422): a
`base_version` without a `guide`, or one that is neither the draft's nor the project
guide's version.

get.description: Polling fallback for the progress stream (GET /runs/{run_id}/events).

Spans in reading order. `flagged` and `code` look at open flags only; a span without a
score never matches a score bound.

post.description: Accept the passage as it is: its open flags become accepted.

409.description: Someone else changed the passage since `base` (code `passage_changed`, with `current_text`), or the run is not open for review.
Someone else changed the passage since `base` (code `passage_changed`, with `current_text`), or the run is not open for review.

post.description:
Re-run the consistency sweep with the project guide, which may be a newer draft of a
file translating alongside this one (spec §8.3).
